axes.model_access: Multi-model orchestration: the official AI Chat help page lists a model picker grouped by vendor plus Mixture-of-Agents, while Super Agent calls models and tools inside its workflow. Users do not choose raw models (2026-11-21).
axes.runtime: Web (genspark.ai) plus apps. The official help centre says Super Agent plans and executes on a cloud computer, with New mode giving each project a fresh cloud computer and Classic mode running without one (2026-11-21).
axes.local_files: Outputs such as reports, pages, sheets and decks live in the account cloud and the project workspace; the official help centre says each project has its own chat, files and cloud computer, and outputs can be downloaded locally. Official pages list no local model surface (2026-11-21).
axes.background: A task model: submit a task → multi-step cloud execution → outputs land in the project library. The official help centre says long jobs can run for up to two hours, keep going after the tab closes, and Super Agent cannot run scheduled jobs (2026-11-21).
axes.tools: Search-plus-report agents are the main axis: Sparkpage reorganises search results into a structured page, with AI Slides/Sheets, website generation and a browser extension also listed. The help centre names reports, decks, spreadsheets, web pages and images as deliverable outputs (2026-11-21).
axes.context: Organised by project: each project carries its own chat, files and cloud computer, so task context persists within the project. The official help centre lists no cross-project long-term memory, and GenTeam states that direct-message content is not carried into group chats (2026-11-21).
axes.permissions: Accounts plus credits/subscriptions. The official help centre says cloud agents consume their creator’s credits, while agents on a personal computer use that machine’s model access. Business plans claim SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and zero model training, with retention and deletion governed by the privacy page (2026-11-21).
axes.fit: Fit: a one-stop search → report → slide pipeline, research deliverables that need a ready-made artefact, and light agent-task outsourcing. Not fit: fully controllable and auditable processes (agent opacity), compliance-first enterprises, or direct mainland access (403 from Cloudflare) (2026-11-21).

runs: This entry checks the official site, help centre and privacy page for capability boundaries. Retrieval quality, source traceability and credit consumption need account-level measurement.
unknowns:
- Source retention in Sparkpage: the help centre gives no item-by-item provenance statement; measure on outputs.
- Credit consumption versus task complexity: the help centre describes the credit system; exact usage follows the account page.
- Scope of enterprise compliance certifications: the business page states SOC 2/ISO claims; request audit reports through sales.
related: Also task agents: Manus is a general-task cloud sandbox, Genspark leans toward research/content artifacts.
Also search-oriented: Perplexity is an answer engine, Genspark an artifact factory.
Also China-background super-agent: Tiangong does docs/PPT/sheets one-stop, Genspark has the Sparkpage line.
